name: gauge-speedometer
title: Gauge Speedometer
description: SVG arc speedometer gauge showing current utilization percentage with color warning thresholds.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Slider Driven Arc Gauge: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
